vectors.given: an active standing responsibility
vectors.when: it is assessed satisfied without basis references
vectors.expect: reject

vectors.given: an active responsibility
vectors.when: discharge is requested before a satisfied assessment or without a Decision
vectors.expect: reject

vectors.given: no qualifying mandate/decision pair
vectors.when: an authorization is issued
vectors.expect: reject

vectors.given: an authorization for one principal/action/resource tuple
vectors.when: the tuple changes
vectors.expect: reject

vectors.given: a durable started provider attempt with no committed result
vectors.when: the same idempotency identity is submitted again
vectors.expect: reconcile exact historical provider/request or remain unknown; never invoke fresh

vectors.given: a historical repeat-safe reconciliation contract
vectors.when: current provider/protocol contract differs
vectors.expect: manual resolution required and no reconciliation call

vectors.given: durable responsibility/work/run state
vectors.when: the runtime process closes and reopens the same store
vectors.expect: stable semantic identities and current projections remain readable

vectors.given: a bundle whose Work references a missing Responsibility
vectors.when: bundle validation/import runs
vectors.expect: reject before durable mutation

vectors.given: a satisfied Responsibility and an unrelated Decision
vectors.when: discharge is requested
vectors.expect: reject

vectors.given: an existing Decision identity
vectors.when: the same id is recorded with different semantics
vectors.expect: reject

vectors.given: an expired Mandate
vectors.when: Authorization issuance is requested
vectors.expect: reject

vectors.given: an expired Authorization
vectors.when: effect use is requested
vectors.expect: reject

vectors.given: a Mandate with empty authority_ceiling
vectors.when: Authorization issuance is requested
vectors.expect: reject

vectors.given: a discharged Responsibility
vectors.when: new Work is admitted
vectors.expect: reject

vectors.given: Work belonging to a discharged Responsibility
vectors.when: a fresh effect is invoked
vectors.expect: reject

vectors.given: a fresh effectful request with no Work
vectors.when: provider invocation is requested
vectors.expect: reject

vectors.given: a Run and unrelated Work
vectors.when: invocation references both
vectors.expect: reject

vectors.given: Authorization with required_context
vectors.when: public Runtime invocation carries mismatched then matched context
vectors.expect: reject mismatch and accept match

vectors.given: an otherwise valid fresh effectful invocation
vectors.when: no durable idempotency identity is supplied
vectors.expect: reject before provider dispatch

vectors.given: a completed or ambiguous effect bound to one idempotency identity
vectors.when: the same identity is reused for a different semantic request
vectors.expect: reject without replay, recovery, or fresh provider invocation

vectors.given: a capability request containing an undeclared top-level field
vectors.when: the request is parsed through the public Runtime invocation schema
vectors.expect: reject before provider selection or effect identity binding

vectors.given: a completed effect bound to one durable idempotency identity
vectors.when: the same request identity is resubmitted with an undeclared provider-specific top-level field
vectors.expect: reject as invalid input; extension data never reaches replay, recovery, or provider execution

vectors.given: an authority-bearing Runtime HTTP command
vectors.when: no authenticated credential is supplied
vectors.expect: reject before semantic mutation

vectors.given: a request authenticated as one principal
vectors.when: Decision.decided_by claims another principal
vectors.expect: reject and record no Decision

vectors.given: an authenticated grantee with a previously valid delegation
vectors.when: the delegation is revoked
vectors.expect: subsequent delegated authentication fails closed

vectors.given: a historical Decision recorded before Runtime Protocol 2.0 without authentication attestation
vectors.when: an authenticated caller replays the same semantic Decision
vectors.expect: reject; historical identity is preserved but no attestation is retroactively created

vectors.given: a historical Authorization without Runtime Protocol 2.0 issuer attestation
vectors.when: an authenticated HTTP caller attempts an external effect with it
vectors.expect: reject before provider dispatch

vectors.given: a delegated actor bounded to one scope and authority ceiling
vectors.when: it attempts to create a Mandate outside that delegation
vectors.expect: reject

vectors.given: a previously valid Runtime bearer credential
vectors.when: the credential is revoked
vectors.expect: subsequent authentication fails closed

vectors.given: an authenticated parent grantee acting through a bounded active parent delegation
vectors.when: the grantee creates a narrower child delegation for another controller
vectors.expect: the child authenticates with the root effective principal and cannot exceed the parent delegation

vectors.given: an active Responsibility and a caller-supplied Work identity
vectors.when: the same Work identity is admitted again with identical semantics
vectors.expect: return the existing Work; changed semantics with the same identity are rejected

vectors.given: an attested Authorization and an external-effect request for a Domain-owned provider
vectors.when: Runtime prepares the effect
vectors.expect: durably bind identity and authorization but do not grant provider dispatch until start succeeds

vectors.given: a prepared Domain effect grant
vectors.when: start succeeds once and is requested again
vectors.expect: reject the second start; never grant a second provider dispatch

vectors.given: a started Domain effect whose provider outcome is unknown
vectors.when: the same idempotency identity is prepared again
vectors.expect: return ambiguous state with dispatch denied until the Domain submits a reconciled final result

vectors.given: a started Domain effect bound to one request and provider
vectors.when: the Domain reports a result for a different request or provider
vectors.expect: reject without committing or rebinding the effect

vectors.given: a prepared Domain effect whose Mandate is revoked before provider dispatch
vectors.when: the Domain requests start
vectors.expect: reject; provider dispatch authority is never granted and Authorization use is not recorded

vectors.given: two independent ledger connections observe the same projection version
vectors.when: both attempt an expected-version transition concurrently
vectors.expect: exactly one transition wins and the other receives a concurrency conflict

vectors.given: two Runtime nodes share one durable Run
vectors.when: different workers concurrently acquire the same lease generation
vectors.expect: exactly one owner obtains the active lease

vectors.given: two Runtime nodes share one prepared Domain effect
vectors.when: both request provider start concurrently
vectors.expect: exactly one receives dispatch authority and Authorization use is recorded once

vectors.given: two Runtime nodes receive the same Runtime-owned effect identity
vectors.when: both invoke concurrently
vectors.expect: only the reservation winner invokes the provider; the competitor replays or reconciles

vectors.given: an institutional lineage whose root has already been superseded by a current head
vectors.when: another Revision attempts to supersede the historical root
vectors.expect: reject the branch and preserve the existing current head

vectors.given: an immutable Decision that has been explicitly superseded by a successor Decision
vectors.when: current applicability is requested for the historical Decision
vectors.expect: reject current use while preserving the historical Decision for audit

vectors.given: a registered ontology type definition version
vectors.when: a new version is presented without then with an explicit Revision
vectors.expect: direct overwrite is rejected; Revision advances current version while preserving history

vectors.given: a qualified Experience that is invalidated or superseded
vectors.when: current applicability is evaluated
vectors.expect: historical/non-qualified Experience is not applicable and a qualified lineage head is

vectors.given: a Mandate with historical Authorization that is superseded by a successor Mandate
vectors.when: the historical Authorization is checked for current use
vectors.expect: preserve historical authorization records but reject current authority through the superseded Mandate

vectors.given: an active Goal that needs revision
vectors.when: a successor Goal is proposed before and after revision-required state with an explicit admission Decision
vectors.expect: reject premature successor admission; accept explicit successor only after the old Goal is revision-required

vectors.given: a recorded Decision whose current qualification is explicitly revoked with basis
vectors.when: the Decision is reused to qualify a current transition
vectors.expect: reject while preserving the historical Decision and revocation history

vectors.given: an Authorization with historical issuance and use records
vectors.when: it is explicitly revoked and a later use is attempted
vectors.expect: reject all later use while preserving issuance, prior uses, and revocation history

vectors.given: a Goal with one current StrategyAssessment
vectors.when: a new assessment is recorded
vectors.expect: reject silent overwrite; accept only explicit supersession of the current assessment with reason and basis

vectors.given: two Runtime nodes execute different durable effect identities under one active reusable Authorization
vectors.when: their authority-use transitions contend
vectors.expect: both distinct effects may reserve and dispatch once; neither is misclassified as replay of the other

vectors.given: two prepared Domain effects use different idempotency identities under one active reusable Authorization
vectors.when: two Runtime nodes start them concurrently
vectors.expect: each distinct effect may obtain one dispatch generation; contention on shared Authorization use does not falsely fence the other effect

vectors.given: a parent Responsibility with an active requires relation to an unresolved child Responsibility
vectors.when: the parent is assessed satisfied
vectors.expect: reject until the required child is explicitly discharged; child discharge does not itself satisfy the parent

vectors.given: a directed hard-dependency path A requires B and B requires C
vectors.when: a Decision attempts to add C requires A
vectors.expect: reject and preserve an acyclic current graph

vectors.given: recorded strategic options and a portfolio proposal
vectors.when: activation is attempted without an applicable Decision
vectors.expect: reject; Runtime never promotes an option or proposal into an active portfolio by score or presence alone

vectors.given: an active portfolio with a resource budget denominated in one unit
vectors.when: an allocation uses another unit or exceeds the durable ceiling
vectors.expect: reject without changing allocation state

vectors.given: a currently usable subject with an active qualification dependency
vectors.when: a new dependency version is observed
vectors.expect: create a targeted ReviewObligation while leaving the owned subject unchanged

vectors.given: an open ReviewObligation assessed as requiring reauthorization, reopen, retirement, or revalidation
vectors.when: the assessment is recorded but no owning-subsystem resolution exists
vectors.expect: keep the review pending until explicit resolution is recorded

vectors.given: an authenticated delegated controller
vectors.when: whole-agency StateBundle export is requested
vectors.expect: reject; only a directly authenticated root principal may export or import complete agency state

vectors.given: durable Responsibility or DomainAssignment state exists
vectors.when: a caller reads it without Runtime authentication
vectors.expect: reject before returning durable semantic state

vectors.given: a Runtime Protocol 4.0 public command with an undeclared top-level field
vectors.when: the HTTP request is parsed
vectors.expect: return validation error before semantic mutation

vectors.given: an authenticated delegated actor whose active delegation lacks the requested Runtime operation
vectors.when: the actor records or performs that generic Runtime transition
vectors.expect: reject even though representation of the root principal is authenticated

vectors.given: a delegated actor with Runtime transition authority but a narrower effect action/resource ceiling
vectors.when: the actor tries to invoke a reality-changing capability outside that ceiling
vectors.expect: reject before fresh dispatch even if a root Authorization identifier is known

vectors.given: a terminal Work
vectors.when: a new Run is started
vectors.expect: reject; historical Work remains readable but cannot authorize fresh execution

vectors.given: an effect was committed under a Run that later became terminal
vectors.when: the same durable effect identity is replayed and a different fresh effect is attempted
vectors.expect: replay the committed result without dispatch, but reject the new fresh effect

vectors.given: a provider result created by one authenticated actor for one effective principal
vectors.when: another principal or another delegated actor attempts to read it
vectors.expect: reject; the original actor and direct owning principal remain authorized
